common.tagline: Enter a world that remembers you.

home.heading: Enter a world that remembers you.
home.subheading: Lorewish is a solo interactive roleplay app — make choices, meet characters who remember you, and watch the story change because of what you did.
home.previewCaption: A short, offline sample of how Lorewish plays. No account needed.
home.newStoryCaption: Quick Start and Advanced Setup are public to explore. Sign-in is required only when starting real generation.
home.foundationNote: Foundation build — Android, iOS and Web from one codebase.

preview.fixtureNotice: Sample scene, not connected to AI generation.

account.signOutError: Couldn't sign out. Please try again.
account.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
account.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to %{email}. Open it to activate your account, then sign in here.
account.errorInvalidCredentials: That email or password isn't right.
account.errorEmailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email before signing in — check your inbox for the link.
account.errorUserAlreadyExists: An account with that email already exists. Try signing in instead.
account.errorWeakPassword: Please choose a longer password (at least 6 characters).
account.errorInvalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right. Please check it and try again.
account.errorUnknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account.guestNotice: You don't need an account to try the reading preview — it stays open to everyone.

setup.subheading: Choose a fast starter, or shape the world and its first important character.
setup.signInToStart: Your setup is saved in this tab. Sign in to start the real story.
setup.premisePlaceholder: What changes when the player arrives?
setup.worldPlaceholder: The place, era, and rules that matter to this story…
setup.playerDescriptionPlaceholder: One or two details the story should remember…
setup.characterRelationshipPlaceholder: A wary ally who remembers an old promise
setup.addressHint: The four slots keep who speaks and who is addressed unambiguous. They remain locked once the story begins.

play.signInRequired: Sign in to play a real story — this is the AI-generated engine, not the offline preview.
play.newStorySubheading: Write a premise. The story is generated directly, and stays exactly where you left it.
play.premisePlaceholder: A wandering healer arrives at a village under a curse…
play.failedBody: Nothing was lost — your last scene is still here.
play.allowanceExhaustedBody: Your story stays here exactly as it is. Come back after the reset to continue.
play.alphaAccessRequired: Real AI play is currently limited to approved alpha testers.
play.setupLockedNotice: Story setup is locked after the first scene. Start a new story to change canonical identity or setting.
